_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Beatriz Souza
about_me: I'm Beatriz, a sommelier who ran the wine program at Kestrel and now consults for restaurants. I want to start a small wine import business focused on Portuguese producers. Looking for a partner with logistics experience.
goals: Launch a Portuguese wine import business

debriefs.text: Tomasz Nowak, the chef-owner of Kestrel, said he'd be my first customer.
Marco Bellini of Olive & Ash wants a new wine list for his Detroit location. I promised to send him a proposal by Sunday.
Luis Romero runs a cold-storage warehouse in Detroit and said they store wine for two importers.
Isaac Feld from A2 Launchpad said the incubator has a food and beverage founders group that meets monthly. He offered to add me to the list.

card.headline: Sommelier and restaurant consultant
card.about: Wine programs; building a Portuguese import business.
